observations.scope: Fresh isolated development stack, two bounded real-provider tasks on synthetic sources, independent code and real Storage reply-loss verification; Windows and complete UI/business acceptance remain open.

Matching Futures/Console BFF and Web packages installed; authenticated readiness only, browser not executed. Storage-only bounded-volume ENOSPC passed. Third synthetic task failed on provider HTTP 503 with one unknown usage; no new quality conclusion.

Runtime Owner in-process transaction test with real isolated PostgreSQL ENOSPC; NOLOGIN SET ROLE pools, in-memory archive and synthetic native receipts; no independent Runtime/Worker/Node/Storage process, real provider, Compact, complete note lifecycle, Windows or host-disk exhaustion.

One new same-input synthetic research task failed on first provider HTTP 503 with no report; frozen Agent 4/Skill 3, native-v4 engine and existing 12-step/12-model-attempt budget verified, reviewer criteria fixed before submission and excluded from input, three old tasks unchanged. Reviewed read-failure UI installed as a matching Futures BFF/Web package; nine other instances unchanged. No browser or Windows acceptance.

Mac isolated PostgreSQL Owner coverage: Telemetry exporter receipt red-green and Runtime outbox protocol; HTTP fixtures; only the five new exporter tests and two Runtime tests use NOLOGIN SET ROLE application pools, not separate login or real Langfuse, continuous-loop liveness or cross-service composition. No installed service, source protocol or deployment pin change.

Two separate Mac fixture layers: Runtime note lifecycle/real PostgreSQL Owner coverage, and native process external-effect reply-loss/cancel/explicit reconcile with real Storage. No production change, installed service replacement, deployment pin change, real provider, Windows or full resource/business acceptance.

runtime_owner.scope: In-process Owner with real PostgreSQL and SourceState HTTP policy, NOLOGIN SET ROLE application pools, synthetic model receipt, memory archive and callback-level reply loss; no SQL-fabricated run state, actual TCP loss, Worker retry loop, official Node or Storage process. runtime_owner.scope: Owner in-process real isolated PostgreSQL and servicehttp authorization, NOLOGIN SET ROLE pools, synthetic native receipt and memory archive. Positive paths use normal APIs; five corrupt-record negative fixtures are deliberate injections. Separate actor invokes old resume in consistency test; GET never performs that action. installed_observation.scope: Twelve named execution/notes table row digests and full terminal task metadata agree at observation endpoints across installation and GETs. HTTP and SQL snapshots are separate; no admission lock or continuous immutability proof. Excludes instances, app_runs, business_runs and all other tables; no live provider retry, Storage-byte validation, UI, business or Windows acceptance.
